# Free Malaysia Today

> > Independent Malaysian news platform delivering comprehensive coverage of current affairs, business, economy, politics, and regional developments across Malaysia and ASEAN.

Free Malaysia Today (FMT) is a leading independent news portal providing bilingual coverage in English and Bahasa Melayu. The platform focuses on Malaysian domestic affairs, regional ASEAN developments, international relations, legal profession updates, and economic analysis including oil prices, trade policies, and market movements.

## Key Topics

- Malaysia
- Ahmad Faizal Azumu
- ASEAN
- Malaysian Bar
- Legal Profession Qualifying Board
- Middle East Conflict
- Oil Prices
- Petrol Subsidies
- Current Affairs
- Business Economy
- Strait of Hormuz
- Wall Street
- Berita Terkini
- Legal Profession
- ASEAN Trade

## Main News Portals

- [Free Malaysia Today Homepage](https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com): Main English-language portal featuring breaking news, current affairs, business, economy, lifestyle, and analysis on Malaysian and international developments
- [FMT Bahasa Melayu](https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/berita): Comprehensive Bahasa Melayu news section (Berita Terkini) covering Malaysian domestic news, international affairs, and regional developments for Malay-speaking audiences
